result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two pages are close in tone and length. Both invent follow-up steps the brief never mentioned (A: a coordinator will reach out and an orientation guide will arrive; B: volunteer guidelines and replying to the email to change or cancel a shift). B wins mainly because its button uses dark text on orange, which is much easier to read than A's white text on light orange. A's lantern icon fits the festival better than B's moon, and neither page's 'back to festival home' button is a very useful next step for a new volunteer. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both are compact, on-theme thank-you screens that make up process details: A invents volunteer guidelines and a reply-to-cancel step, and B invents a coordinator who will reach out and an orientation guide. A has better contrast on its button (dark text on orange), while B's white text on light orange looks too faint. Both end with a generic 'Back to festival home' button that isn't really a next step for a new volunteer.
